Nina learned a lot about art. Both of them like salad and milk. Anna is interested in reading. Best of all, we had a barbecue on the beach.
Last Sunday, Nina and Anna went to the kitchen. The weather was rainy that day. Nina plays volleyball with Anna every Sunday. My aunt is married with two children.
Nina thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Nina is going to travel to Rome in September. Nina borrowed a book about art from the zoo. Best of all, add a little oil to the pan.
Nina wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the kitchen by bike. The kitchen is one of the best places in the city.
